_comment: Golden vectors for JSON control messages. Each valid message must parse and re-serialize to an equal JSON value; each invalid one must be refused. See spec/control-messages.md.

valid.name: commit without a preceding pending (late joiner) is just a commit
rotation prepared for a local requester
rotation prepared for a remote requester

invalid.name: get service file path without service_id

tolerated_unknown_loss_kinds.name: loss with a kind from a newer server

tolerated_unknown_abort_reasons.name: abort reason from a newer server
